info: Plan F – open study nook. Instead of a closed study room, two standing desks sit against the west wall in an open nook beside the living room, with wall cabinets and a lit shelf above and a reading chair. Bedroom 3 stays a proper guest bedroom, the dining table for 8 sits outside an open kitchen (bi-fold glass to close it when cooking), and the living room keeps the marble TV wall with a tall storage cabinet. Nothing is fixed to the household shelter walls. Removing the kitchen front wall must be confirmed with HDB / your ID. Power points and trunking are indicative.
